name: Vestibular Neuritis
definition: Acute prolonged vertigo from unilateral peripheral vestibular dysfunction without hearing loss, usually lasting hours to days.

typical: No focal hearing loss in typical neuritis

core: Head impulse test in expert hands

investigations.principle: Clinical differentiation from stroke is critical.
investigations.MRI: MRI brain may be needed when central cause cannot be confidently excluded.

green: Short-term symptom control only when necessary
amber: Prolonged vestibular suppressants can delay compensation; steroid use is individualized.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhrama phenotype may be documented while stroke exclusion remains mandatory.

patientEducation.summary: Acute prolonged vertigo from unilateral peripheral vestibular dysfunction without hearing loss, usually lasting hours to days.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
